The **All India Trinamool Congress** (**AITC**), alternatively the **Trinamool Congress** (**TMC**; transl. Grassroots Congress), is an Indian political party based in the state of West Bengal founded by Mamata Banerjee in 1998. AITC began as a breakaway faction of the Indian National Congress and rapidly rose to prominence in the politics of West Bengal under Banerjee's leadership. In the 2001 Vidhan Sabha elections, the AITC won 60 seats in alliance with the INC, becoming the principal opposition party. In the 2009 Lok Sabha election, AITC won 19 seats in West Bengal, in alliance with the Congress.

reranked_evidence.snippet: #### physical therapy, occupational therapy & speech therapy. TMC provides personalized physical, occupational, and speech therapy supported by specialized programs - including stroke recovery, fall prevention, cardiopulmonary care, Parkinson’s, and low vision services - delivered across skilled nursing facilities, hospitals, clinics, assisted and independent living communities, and even in the home. As a trusted, privately-owned nationwide contract therapy provider since 1995, TMC delivers solution-driven services such as census development, coding support, denial prevention, and nurse recruiting, while offering clinical programs proven to reduce rehospitalizations and maximize efficiency; our dedicated teams integrate seamlessly into each facility’s culture, with a strategic focus on enhancing both patient outcomes and operational success. Our teams deliver evidence-based physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy services that support patient progress and facility goals. By integrating physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy into one collaborative model, we help support stronger outcomes across the continuum of care.
